## 说明

该函数接收渔区数据和一个国家名称，分析该国的渔获量，并按产量找出排名在指定范围内的主要物种。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

This function takes the fishing area data and a country name,
analyzes the catch of that country, and identifies the top species
based on production within the specified rank range.

</details>

## 用法

```r
country_species(
  area_data,
  country_name,
  rank_range = c(1, 10),
  plot = TRUE,
  table = TRUE,
  timeseries_analysis = TRUE,
  time_analysis_text_displacement = 10,
  h_value = 0.15,
  ZH = FALSE,
  lang = NULL,
  pptx = getOption("faofishingreport.pptx", FALSE)
)
```

## 参数

`area_data`
:   包含渔区数据的数据框，例如`fishing_area_data()`返回的`area_data`。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A data frame containing the fishing area data.

    </details>

`country_name`
:   字符串，要分析的国家（FAO的英文国家名，与数据中一致，如"Morocco"）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A string specifying the country to be analyzed.

    </details>

`rank_range`
:   长度为2的数值向量，指定要分析的物种的排名范围（按该国历年总产量排序）。默认为`c(1, 10)`。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the rank range of species to be analyzed.

    </details>

`plot`
:   逻辑值，是否生成并保存图表。默认为TRUE。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value indicating whether to generate and save plots.

    </details>

`table`
:   逻辑值，是否生成表格并保存到`tables/`目录。默认为TRUE。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value indicating whether to generate and save tables

    </details>

`timeseries_analysis`
:   逻辑值，决定分面图的内容：为TRUE（默认）时显示线性趋势线和突变点（相邻突变点之间各时段的平均产量）；为FALSE时显示平滑（loess）曲线。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value indicating whether to analysis timeseries.

    </details>

`time_analysis_text_displacement`
:   分面时间序列图中占比标签的位置：标签放在数据首个年份（所选物种首次有产量的年份）之后第几年处。默认为10。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The number of years after the first year of data at which
    the percentage labels are placed in the faceted time series plot. Default is 10.

    </details>

`h_value`
:   突变点检验（`strucchange::breakpoints()`的参数`h`）中相邻突变点之间时段的最短长度：小于1时为占序列长度的比例，大于等于1时为年数。默认为0.15，即每个时段至少占序列长度的15%。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The minimum segment size passed to `strucchange::breakpoints()`: a fraction of
    the series length (default 0.15) or a number of years.

    </details>

`ZH`
:   逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表文字和名称使用中文。默认为FALSE。`ZH = TRUE`等同于`lang = "zh"`。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. If TRUE, chart text and names are in Chinese. Default is FALSE. `ZH = TRUE` is the same as `lang = "zh"`.

    </details>

`lang`
:   图表文字和名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL：`ZH = TRUE`时使用"zh"，否则使用`fao_settings()`设置的语言（未更改时为"en"）。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    The language of the chart text and names: "en" (English), "zh" (Chinese) or "both"
    (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses "zh" if `ZH = TRUE`, and otherwise the language
    set with `fao_settings()` ("en" unless changed).

    </details>

`pptx`
:   逻辑值。图表总是以PNG格式保存在figures/png/；为TRUE时还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件，保存在figures/pptx/。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。

    <details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

    A logical value. Charts are always saved as PNG in `figures/png/`; if TRUE they are
    also saved as editable PowerPoint files in `figures/pptx/`. Default is FALSE, which can be
    changed for all functions with `fao_settings(pptx = TRUE)`.

    </details>

## 返回值

一个数据框，包含该国家逐年捕捞排名范围内各物种的产量（其余物种合并为一类）。`plot`和`table`为TRUE时保存图表和表格。

<details class="fao-en"><summary>English</summary>

A data frame with the yearly catch of the country by the ranked species (the others
grouped). Charts and tables are saved if `plot` and `table` are TRUE.

</details>

## 另请参阅

## 示例

```r
country_species(FAO34[["area_data"]], country_name = "Morocco",c(1, 10), plot=TRUE,table=TRUE) #area_data=Fao34
```
